title: Asset and Cipher
author: Marguerite Quintana
blurb: Freya Villalobos, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
